data.name: Alfonso
data.gender_notes: Alfonso is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German words 'alf' (elf) and 'sauwun' (sovereign, noble), Alfonso means 'Noble, ready for battle'. This name has been borne by several saints and royal figures throughout history, most notably Saint Alfonso Maria de Ligorio and Alfonso X of Castile. The name Alfonso carries the meaning “Noble, ready for battle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Alfonso usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, ready for battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Alfonso belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, ready for battle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alfonso total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: אלפונסו
in_hebrew.meaning: אלפונסו משמעותו מוכן למלחמה או נדיב למלחמה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלפונסו הוא שם משפחה וגם שם פרטי שמקורו בספרדית ומשמעותו מוכן למלחמה או נדיב למלחמה. השם אלפונסו מורכב משתי מילים: 'אלפא' שפירושה מוכן או נדיב ו-'פונסו' שפירושה מלחמה. השם אלפונסו היה שמו של מספר מלכים בספרד ובפורטוגל, ביניהם אלפונסו השישי, מלך קסטיליה.

in_greek.name: Αλφόνσο
in_greek.meaning: Αλφόνσο σημαίνει έτοιμος για πόλεμο ή γενναίος στον πόλεμο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλφόνσο προέρχεται από την ισπανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει έτοιμος για πόλεμο ή γενναίος στον πόλεμο. Το όνομα Αλφόνσο αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'αλφά' που σημαίνει έτοιμος ή γενναίος και 'φόνσο' που σημαίνει πόλεμος. Το όνομα Αλφόνσο ήταν το όνομα πολλών βασιλέων στην Ισπανία και την Πορτογαλία, μεταξύ των οποίων και ο Αλφόνσος ΣΤ', βασιλιάς της Καστιλίας.

in_latin.name: Alphonso
in_latin.meaning: Alphonso means ready for war or noble in war
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Alphonso originates from Spanish and means ready for war or noble in war. It is composed of two words: 'alpha' meaning ready or noble and 'phonso' meaning war. The name Alphonso was borne by several kings in Spain and Portugal, including Alfonso VI, King of Castile.

in_english.name: Alfonso
in_english.meaning: Alfonso means ready for battle or noble warrior
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alfonso is of Spanish origin, derived from the Gothic words 'alms' meaning ready or noble and 'fonso' meaning battle or warrior. It signifies one who is prepared for battle or a noble warrior. Historically, Alfonso was the name of several Spanish and Portuguese kings, including Alfonso VI of Castile, who played a significant role in the Christian reconquest of the Iberian Peninsula. The name conveys strength, courage, and nobility, reflecting the valorous characteristics of its bearers throughout history.
